information:
![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png)

From the organizers that brought you SacCubing, comes SacQuiet Spring 2023! **This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events.** If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [SacCubing XIV 2023,](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXIV2023/) happening on May 20th, the day before.
# Lunch will be provided
- The registration fee is built in to include an all-expenses paid for competitor lunch, courtesy of Domino's Pizza. If you'd like an alternative lunch, feel free to leave the venue however this portion will not be compensated.
